ModMetaData.name: Quick Dumping Zone Presets
ModMetaData.author: lhany
ModMetaData.description:
Quick Stockpile Zones
A mod for players who find even setting up presets too bothersome.
This mod adds a right-click menu to the vanilla 'Dumping stockpile zone' designator, allowing you to instantly place 6 pre-configured zones without opening the filter tab.
Priority is automatically set to 'Important'.
Included Zones Chunk Zone: Allows stone chunks, steel slag chunks, and mechanoid chunks. Toxic Wastepack Zone: Allows only toxic wastepacks. Corpse Zone: Allows all corpses. Mechanoid Corpse Zone: Allows mechanoid and drone corpses. Structure Zone: Allows all minified/packaged structures (entire Buildings category). Butcher Zone: Allows only animals (no rotten). Priority is automatically set to 'Critical'.
Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3791487984
